data.body: [P2] Validate supplied SDK-request sequence values. The published schema requires `sdkRequests[].sequence` to be a nonnegative integer, but this loop never checks it. Adding `sequence: true`, `-1`, or a string to the existing valid disposal fixture's pre-closure SDK request leaves validation successful, although the wire schema rejects it. The physical audit also overlooks malformed sequences when handoff timestamps differ from call boundaries. Check presence with `is_json_integer` and nonnegativity here, and cover both validation paths with regression tests.
